snippet.title: [EN] Alterum - Announcement Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
At their next site, a group of brave explorers encounters something inexplicable: some of them are possessed by restless souls. Those who were recently loyal companions have become something "altered". Multiplayer for 4–8 players. How well do you know your friends?

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424420/Alterum/
